cp: deuterosomal cell vs fetal lung multiciliated progenitor

Identical defining set [DEUP1, CDC20B, CCNO] on both. Discriminators: developmental_stage (fetal progenitor carries DS=['development'], deuterosomal cell is adult airway) and the required delta (fetal = MCIDAS; adult deuterosomal = PLK4 + FOXN4).
